question.problem:
Given that the function

$$
g(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{log}_{2}\,(x+{b}^{2}), & x\le 3 \\ x-1, & x>3\end{aligned}
$$

 
is continuous at  $x=3,$  find the possible values of $b.$

Arranged in **ascending order**,

$b=$
{{field-1}} $\,$ and $\,b=$

{{field-2}}.
question.worked_solution:
At $x=3,$ the left-sided limit is

$$
{lim}_{x\to {3}^{-}}g(x)={lim}_{x\to {3}^{-}}{log}_{2}\,(x+{b}^{2})={log}_{2}\,(3+{b}^{2}),
$$

and the right-sided limit is

$$
{lim}_{x\to {3}^{+}}g(x)={lim}_{x\to {3}^{+}}(x-1)=3-1=2.
$$

In order for $g(x)$ to be continuous at $x=3,$ we require that

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to {3}^{+}}g(x) & ={lim}_{x\to {3}^{-}}g(x) \\ {log}_{2}\,(3+{b}^{2}) & =2 \\ 3+{b}^{2} & ={2}^{2} \\ 3+{b}^{2} & =4 \\ {b}^{2} & =1 \\ b & =-1,\,1.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the function is continuous at $x=3$ for the values

$$
b=-1\,\text{and}\,b=1.
$$
